newsitem.title: USA: Permanent enacts director domicile bylaw.
newsitem.headline: Permanent enacts director domicile bylaw.

text.p: Permanent Bancorp Inc said its board enacted a bylaw amendment requiring directors to have a permanent domicile in any county within a 50-mile radius of any of the bank holding company's branches.

The amendment is meant "to ensure that directors of the corporation are knowledgeable of and actively involved in the corporation's primary market area, the source of the vast majority of the company's loans and deposits," it said.
The company said the board also extended the deadline for shareholder nominations to the board to June 17 from April 25. The company's annual meeting is scheduled for July 22.
"This action was taken to permit shareholders ample time to nominate qualified persons to the board of directors in light of the enactment of the director geographic qualification," the company said.

A group of Michigan investors, including Lasalle Capital Management Inc, last week said it expected to assert its shareholder rights regarding its 5.7-percent, or 121,000-share, investment in Permanent.
The group said in a U.S. Securities & Exchange Commission filing that it intends to seek two board seats and to influence the board to consider strategic alternatives, possibly including a merger.
